intro.title: So, who am I?
paragraphs: My name is Rudra, and I’m from Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. I am currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Physics (Hons.) from UPES, Dehradun. Outside my academics, I experiment with illustration, animation, philosophy, stories, and scripts. I tend to be observant and curious to understand things, and I enjoy exploring ideas that intrigue me. Interestingly, I was part of the moderation team of one of India’s most active Discord community servers, and I built this website in one day using generic AI because I was bored.

Honestly, I also don't know who I am. Someone who always has something going on in his mind, or someone who listens to songs 24×7 and stays distracted. Someone who wonders about everything and always stays curious, or someone who, out of the blue, started learning animation and writing stories. Someone with philosophical perspectives, or someone who likes to observe people without judging them. Someone who hates this world for being as it is, or someone who loves it for its beauty and complexity.

thinking.title: how I think
paragraphs: At times i think about most stupid things, and at times I think about the most complex things. What I dont like to think about are the things I have no cntrol over and it still affects me. I like to keep myself distracted most of the time, coz sometimes i get anxious and awkward in unfamiliar and social situations.
I do my best thinking late at night, overthinking about things that are not even that important or some random useless thing.

facts.title: random facts about me
items: I'm a professional music listener. By professional, I mean I listen to music approximately 24×7 and receive absolutely no salary for it. Humanity really needs to rethink its economic system.
I have never finished a to-do list.
I talk to myself more than I talk to others.
There was a time when i used to study 14 hours a day and ironanically there was also a time when i used tto sleep 14 hours a day, both were exhausting and lasted for 3 months in my life.
I have the habit of starting projects I never finish.
I like cold coffee.
My personality type is INTP, which is a fancy way of saying I overthink everything.
I have a habit of overthinking and overanalyzing things, which can be both a blessing and a curse.
I have a love-hate relationship with social media.
I have a tendency to procrastinate, but I also have bursts of productivity that can be quite intense.
I am someone who is emotionally detached and feel empathetic toward people who are genuinely trying their best at the same time.
I have a tendency to get lost in my own thoughts, create scenario and fantasies in my head, daydreaming about random things and can sometimes be oblivious to my surroundings.
I have a habit of overanalyzing social interactions and replaying conversations in my mind.
I have a habit of collecting interesting books related to philosophy, psychology and cosmology even if I don't always read them all.
I have a fascination with the human mind and often explore topics related to psychology and sociology.
I am intrigued by the strange ways people develop completely opposite opinions while looking at the exact same event.
I tend to question things quite a lot. Authority, opinions, traditions, philosophy, political narratives, my own assumptions... basically anything that starts with “everyone knows that…
I don't speak a lot in front of random people but I can talk endlessly about meaningless things when I am with people that are comfortable with who I am and don't judge me for being weird.

Sometimes I truly hate this world for what it is. For its cruelty, hypocrisy, selective compassion, superiority complex, and how humans generalize a situation when it doesn't fit their narrative using a trivial example that satisfies their biases.
